project_type: Full-stack web app: PHP 8.2 REST API backend (Render/Docker) + static HTML5/CSS3/JS frontend (Netlify) + MongoDB Atlas. Greenfield; only DESIGN.md exists at the workspace root; backend/ and frontend/ directories exist but are empty.
language: Backend: PHP 8.2. Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, vanilla JavaScript (ES6).
build_system: Backend: Composer with PSR-4 autoloading (App namespace mapped to src/); deployed via Docker (php:8.2-apache). Frontend: no build step (static files served by Netlify). NOTE: composer and PHP are NOT installed in this environment; vendor/ is never committed (composer install runs inside Docker).
test_framework: None. No automated test suite exists or is required. Verification is purely static: JSON parse validation + manual PHP syntax/structure review + cross-checks (endpoint-to-controller, HTML-id-to-JS).
build_command: Backend: 'docker build' on Render runs 'composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader'. Frontend: none. Locally no build is available (php/composer not installed).
test_command: No test runner. Validate JSON with: python -m json.tool <file>  (Python 3.14 is available). php -l is NOT available (PHP not installed) so PHP verification is a manual review.
verification_instructions: 1) Validate JSON: python -m json.tool backend/composer.json ; python -m json.tool backend/seed/courses.json ; and any seed content JSON. 2) PHP: php -l on every .php IF php is present; ELSE manual review of each .php (balanced braces/quotes, correct class and method signatures, namespace + use statements, every class referenced in public/index.php exists under src/ and is PSR-4 autoloadable as App\...). 3) Endpoint-to-controller cross-check: every row of DESIGN.md section 12 maps to a route in public/index.php and a controller method that exists. 4) HTML-to-JS id cross-check: each frontend HTML page links the css/js it needs and every element id referenced by that page's JS exists in the HTML. 5) Folder structure matches DESIGN.md section 13 (frontend/ and backend/ trees). 6) Cannot runtime-test (no MongoDB Atlas, no Render, no PHP).
snapshot_or_generated_files: backend/vendor/ is generated by composer install inside Docker and must NOT be committed (gitignore it). No other checked-in snapshots.
environment_constraints: PHP and composer are NOT installed locally -> cannot run php -l or composer install; backend verification is manual syntax review + JSON parse. No MongoDB Atlas cluster and no Render -> the full app cannot be run end-to-end here. Node and Python ARE available. contribution_requirements: Greenfield solo project; no AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md present. Follow DESIGN.md as the authoritative spec: implement the exact snippets in sections 11.1-11.8, 13 (.htaccess), and 15 (Dockerfile) faithfully, extended to cover all of section 12. Commit per FEAT on the current branch; never push. Never commit .env (only .env.example) or vendor/.
key_patterns: Router (DESIGN 11.2): an array of tuples [method, '#regex#', [Controller::class, 'method'], roles|null]; AuthMiddleware::require($roles) returns the JWT payload (sub/role/stream/exp) or sends 401/403; controllers obtain the DB via the Database singleton and cast ids with the MongoDB BSON ObjectId constructor inside try/catch (return 400 via Response on a malformed id); Response::json($success,$data,$message,$status=200) is the single response shape {success,data,message}. Frontend (DESIGN 11.6/11.7): an api() fetch helper with a loading banner shown after 3s and 401->clear token + redirect to login.html; NEVER use innerHTML with user/API content, use textContent or createElement; JWT stored in localStorage; KaTeX for $...$ and $$...$$ math; the code playground runs in an iframe with sandbox='allow-scripts' via srcdoc (never run student PHP server-side).
relevant_files: DESIGN.md (authoritative spec; read sections 6, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15 in full)
directory_structure: Root: DESIGN.md, backend/, frontend/, .agents/tasks/. backend/: Dockerfile, composer.json, .env.example, public/ (index.php, .htaccess), src/ (config/Database.php, helpers/Response.php, middleware/AuthMiddleware.php + Cors.php, controllers/<15 controllers>, models/), seed/ (courses.json, load.php). frontend/: *.html (index, login, register, courses, lesson, playground, quiz, dashboard, forum, certificate), admin/ (users, courses, reports).html, css/style.css, js/ (config, api, auth, courses, playground, dashboard, lesson, quiz, forum, certificate).js, js/admin/ (users, courses, reports).js, _headers.
